# Happ CLI (happ-windows-cli) — Complete System Architecture & Operational Manual

## Summary
Happ CLI is an open-source, lightweight command-line interface and terminal TUI application for the Happ VPN / Xray proxy network. It supports Windows (PowerShell, CMD, Terminal), Linux, and macOS.

Repository: https://github.com/Abeh995/happ-cli
Author: Abeh995
License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0)

## System Architecture

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                    Terminal (PowerShell / CMD / Bash)                 |
|            Commands: happ, happ connect, happ mode, happ list         |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
                                    |
          +-------------------------+-------------------------+
          |                                                   |
[Mode 1: TUN Mode (Default)]                [Mode 2: System Proxy Mode]
Layer-3 Virtual Network Adapter             Windows Internet Settings (WinINet)
Wintun Driver (`happ-cli-tun`)              Configures HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS registry
Hijacks 100% of System Traffic & DNS        Routes browsers & proxy-aware apps
Requires Administrator terminal             Standard User (No Admin required)
          |                                                   |
          +-------------------------+-------------------------+
                                    |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
|               Local Core Engine (127.0.0.1:10808 / 10809)            |
|  - Embedded Xray-core (VLESS Reality / VMess / Trojan / Shadowsocks)  |
|  - Active Sniffing for TLS, HTTP, and QUIC (IPIfNonMatch strategy)    |
|  - Encrypted Remote DoH Resolvers (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 / Google 8.8.8.8)|
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

## Supported Proxy Protocols
- **VLESS:** Supports Reality security, WebSocket transport, gRPC, and raw TCP.
- **VMess:** Standard and encrypted WebSocket/TCP configs.
- **Trojan:** TLS-encrypted proxying.
- **Shadowsocks:** Modern AEAD ciphers.

## Windows Automated Installation
```powershell
powershell -c "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeh995/happ-cli/main/windows/install.ps1 | iex"
```

## Command Reference
| Command | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| `happ` | Open interactive terminal dashboard (TUI) |
| `happ connect` | Connect to preferred node as detached background daemon |
| `happ connect --tun` | Connect with Layer-3 Wintun TUN mode |
| `happ connect --proxy` | Connect with Windows System Proxy mode |
| `happ connect <ID>` | Connect directly to node ID |
| `happ disconnect` | Terminate background daemons and restore direct network |
| `happ status` | Display connection status, daemon PIDs, and public egress IP |
| `happ mode [tun/proxy]` | View or change default connection mode |
| `happ list [page]` | Browse proxy nodes with paginated view |
| `happ select <ID/query>` | Select active server by index or country name |
| `happ sub add <URL>` | Import new subscription link |
| `happ sub update` | Refresh all subscription nodes |
| `happ sub list` | View saved subscriptions and quota telemetry |
| `happ ping all` | Benchmark live TCP latency across all nodes |
| `happ help` | Print command-line usage reference |
